say:1:1610312001:1.text: <style="highlight">Pippa</style>, how did you end up in the water?

say:2:1610312002:0.text: Achoo! I accidentally fell in... I could've swum back, but those <style="highlight">nasty fish</style> bit and held onto my clothes. It was so hard to pull free.
say:2:1610312002:0.source_cn: 我……阿嚏！我不小心掉下去了……其实我能游上来的，可那...

say:3:1610312003:1.text: These fish are all tough and gruff and look as rigid as a riff! I've never seen their like in our lake before...
say:3:1610312003:1.source_cn: 那些鱼摸起来硬梆梆的，长得也硬梆梆的，我以前都没在湖里...

say:5:1610312004:1.text: Hey, is that the sound of the bell?

say:6:1610312005:1.text: The assembly bell has rung. Let's talk about this later. We have to get to the island quickly so we don't miss the opening ceremony.
say:6:1610312005:1.source_cn: 嗯，这些回头再说吧，集合的钟声已经响了，我们得快些上岛...

say:7:1610312006:1.text: Yeah, no worries. Thanks for saving me, by the way.
say:7:1610312006:1.source_cn: 啊好的，总之，谢谢你们救了我……
